description: Add a shift to the roster, assigned to an employee or left open. Created as a DRAFT unless publish is true (publishing can notify the employee). Deputy returns an empty 200 on success — use deputy_list_shifts to find the new shift's id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster.

area_id.description: Area (OperationalUnit id) the shift is for.

employee_id.description: Employee to put on the shift. Omit (and set open: true) for an unfilled shift.

end_time.description: Shift end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

force_overwrite.description: Overwrite a clashing shift for the same employee. Default false.

mealbreak_minutes.description: Unpaid meal break length in minutes.

open.description: Show the shift as open for employees to claim.

publish.description: Publish now. Publishing can notify the employee. Default false (draft).

start_time.description: Shift start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

name: deputy_create_shift
title: Create a shift
